en.headline: Transport Advisory Committee discusses Star Ferry fare increase application
en.dek: Members balanced the operator’s financial viability against public acceptability for proposed rises of about 30 per cent on the two franchised cross-harbour routes.

zh.headline: 交諮會討論天星小輪兩航線加價申請 將向政府提交建議
zh.dek: 委員已平衡渡輪服務長遠財務可行性與公眾對擬議約三成加幅的接受程度，稍後提交建議供行政會議考慮。

en.headline: Labour Department lowers thresholds for heat stress at work warnings from Friday
en.dek: Two new trigger conditions will allow higher-level alerts to be issued more readily when temperatures reach extreme levels or an extreme heat special alert is in force.

zh.headline: 勞工處明日起優化工作暑熱警告 下調門檻及自動調高一級
zh.dek: 新增兩項觸發條件，當天文台發極端酷熱特別提示或全港多處氣溫達35度或以上時，可更早發出更高級別警告。

en.headline: Fisherman dies after suspected lightning strike on sampan off Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 67-year-old man was found unconscious on a sampan near the Cross Bay Link during the red rainstorm warning and was certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.

zh.headline: 將軍澳六旬漁民疑遭雷擊 舢舨上昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 紅雨期間一名67歲男子在跨灣大橋對開海面舢舨上暈倒，送將軍澳醫院後證實死亡，初步懷疑遭雷電擊中。

en.headline: Privacy watchdog arrests 29-year-old man over alleged doxxing after boxing match
en.dek: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said the Chinese national was detained in Kowloon today and granted bail pending further investigation.

zh.headline: 私隱專員公署拘29歲男 涉拳賽後「起底」對手
zh.dek: 公署今日在九龍區拘捕一名中國籍男子，涉嫌未經同意披露個人資料，已准保釋繼續調查。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 2:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the warning at noon, expecting isolated thunderstorms over the territory this afternoon.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午2時30分
zh.dek: 天文台中午延長警告，預料本港今午有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: City Chamber Orchestra premieres Space Fantasy in Tsuen Wan this weekend
en.dek: Three English-language family performances run on Saturday and Sunday at Tsuen Wan Town Hall Auditorium, with tickets from HK$120 at URBTIX.

zh.headline: 城市室樂團《太空幻遊》本周末荃灣大會堂首演
zh.dek: 周六下午3時及晚上7時半、周日下午3時於荃灣大會堂演奏廳演出，英語家庭節目，門票120至600元於城市售票網發售。

en.headline: Taxi spins on wet Lung Cheung Road flyover and hits motorcycle
en.dek: The rider was taken to hospital after the late-night crash near Choi Hung Estate; some lanes on the flyover were closed for a time.

zh.headline: 龍翔道天橋的士天雨路滑打轉 撞電單車鐵騎士送院
zh.dek: 周三近午夜彩虹邸對開天橋彎位發生車禍，運輸署一度封閉來回部分行車線；警方正調查意外起因。

en.headline: Man rescued after falling 30 metres on Fei Ngo Shan slope
en.dek: Rescuers found him conscious about two hours after a report near Jat's Incline before dawn and took him to United Christian Hospital.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山男子墮約30米山坡被困 清晨救起送院
zh.dek: 警方凌晨近4時接報扎山道一帶有人失足被困，救援人員約5時41分在山邊尋獲事主，清醒送聯合醫院。

en.headline: John Lee says Hongkong Post must be reformed after heavy losses
en.dek: The Chief Executive said transition arrangements were inevitable as about 200 staff finishing probation in September will be offered two-year contracts instead of permanent terms.

zh.headline: 李家超：香港郵政必須改革 約200人改兩年合約
zh.dek: 行政長官指郵政署2024/25年度虧損約8億元，商經局將研究改革方案提交立法會；9月試用期屆滿員工改以兩年公務員合約續聘。

en.headline: Castle Peak Power cleared to trial hydrogen blend at Lung Kwu Tan plant
en.dek: The government’s hydrogen working group has in principle approved a project to mix up to 5 per cent hydrogen with natural gas in an existing combined-cycle unit.

zh.headline: 龍鼓灑發電廠獲准試驗氫氣混燃 目標摻氫最高5%
zh.dek: 環境及生態局表示，氫能源跨部門工作小組原則上同意青山發電有限公司在現有聯合循環機組混燒氫氣與天然氣。

en.headline: Private home prices fall 0.46 per cent in July after 13-month rise
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department’s index slipped to 321.5, while the rental index hit a record 207.4 after a further monthly gain.

zh.headline: 7月私樓售價指數跌0.46% 連升13個月後轉跌
zh.dek: 差飼物業估價署數字顯示指數報321.5點，今年首七個月仍累升約7.3%；租金指數再創新高。

en.headline: Hong Kong tops Asian cities internationality index, widening lead on Singapore
en.dek: The General Chamber of Commerce scored the city 74.6 out of 100, two points ahead of Singapore, in its second annual ranking of 11 Asian cities.

zh.headline: 總商會國際化指數港蟬聯亞洲第一 領先新加坡拉開至兩分
zh.dek: 香港總商會公布2026年亞洲城市國際化指數，本港獲74.6分居首，較新加坡高兩分，領先幅度較去年擴大。

en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning cancelled; thunderstorms still expected until noon
en.dek: The Observatory cancelled the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 10:15 a.m. after downgrading from Red earlier, and extended the Thunderstorm Warning until 12:30 p.m.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨警告取消 雷暴警告延長至中午12時半
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時15分取消黃色暴雨警告，紅雨今早一度生效後已改發黃雨；雷暴警告延長至下午12時30分。

en.headline: Janice Vidal and Gigi Yim share Ultimate Song Chart stage on Saturday
en.dek: Commercial Radio 903’s concert She and Her Secret is scheduled for 7 p.m. on 29 August at AsiaWorld-Expo Arena, pairing the two singers on a single billed night.

zh.headline: 衛蘭炎明熹周六亞博拉闊音樂會同台
zh.dek: 吆哮903主辦《拉闊音樂會 她和她的秘密》訂於8月29日晚上7時在亞洲國際博覽館Arena舉行。

en.headline: Man arrested for drink-driving after car flips on Princess Margaret Road
en.dek: Police said a 48-year-old driver failed a breath test after his private car hit a barrier and overturned near Hung Hom on Wednesday night; he was not injured.

zh.headline: 公主道私家車撞壤翻側 48歲司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指車輛周三晚在紅磬公主道近治民街失控撞壤翻側，司機酒精呼氣測試不合格，沒有受傷。

en.headline: Three appear in court after 38 kg ketamine seizure at airport
en.dek: Customs said two passengers arriving from Rome and one from Kuala Lumpur were charged with trafficking dangerous drugs after officers found about 38 kilograms of suspected ketamine worth some HK$15 million.

zh.headline: 機場檢38公斤懷疑氯胺酮 三人今西九龍提堂
zh.dek: 海關在兩宗旅客案件共檢獲約38公斤懷疑K仔，市值約1,500萬元，三人被控販運危險藥物。

en.headline: Customs seize HK$8.3 million illicit cigarettes in Tsing Yi flat
en.dek: Officers raided a 600-square-foot private-estate unit used as a storage, packing and distribution centre, arresting a 28-year-old local man after finding about 1.86 million suspected untaxed cigarettes.

zh.headline: 海關青衣私樓搗私煙倉 檢186萬支煙拔28歲男子
zh.dek: 關員在青衣私人屋苑約600平方呎單位檢獲約186萬支懷疑私煙，市值約830萬元，應課稅值約610萬元。

en.headline: Tai Po water supply restored after overnight main repair
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said supply to Tai Yuen Estate, Ting Nga Court and Tai Yuen Shopping Centre began returning to normal from about 6 a.m. after crews finished emergency works on On Po Road.

zh.headline: 大埔安埔路水管搶修完成 大元邸汀雅苑今早復水
zh.dek: 水務署表示通宵完成緊急維修，大元邸、汀雅苑及大元商場食水供應由今早約6時起陸續恢復正常。

en.headline: Hong Kong Sinfonietta plays Bach’s Legacy at City Hall tonight
en.dek: Recorder player Stefan Temmingh and harpsichordist Sebastian Wienand join the orchestra’s string musicians at 8 p.m. for a programme of Bach family works and an Asian première.

zh.headline: 香港小交響樂團今晚城廳上演「巴赫的傳承」
zh.dek: 直笛演奏家Stefan Temmingh與鍵琴家Sebastian Wienand今晚8時在香港大會堂音樂廳，與樂團弦樂組演出巴赫家族作品及一闕亞洲首演。

en.headline: Health spending rose 5 per cent to HK$262.5 billion last year
en.dek: The Health Bureau said recurrent health expenditure in 2024/25 reached HK$262.513 billion, or 8.2 per cent of GDP, with public spending accounting for just over half.

zh.headline: 上年度醫療經常開支2625億 按年增5%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局公布2024/25年度本地醫療衞生總開支帳目，經常性開支2625.13億元，佔本地生產總值8.2%，人均34890元。

en.headline: Charger fire at So Uk Estate injures three and kills four cats
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a ninth-floor flat at Carnation House before dawn after a portable charger overheated; about 80 residents were evacuated.

zh.headline: 蘇屋邭充電器起火三人送院 單位四貓不治
zh.dek: 長沙灣蘇屋邭石竹樓九樓單位清晨充電器過熱起火，消防約半小時救熄，約80人疏散，三人送院，單位內四隻家貓搶救後不治。

en.headline: Red Rainstorm Warning issued; morning and whole-day classes suspended
en.dek: The Observatory upgraded to a Red Rainstorm Warning at 5:05 a.m., with a Thunderstorm Warning in force until 8:30 a.m., and the Education Bureau suspended morning and whole-day school classes.

zh.headline: 天文台改發紅色暴雨警告 上午校及全日制學校停課
zh.dek: 天文台今晨5時05分改發紅色暴雨警告，雷暴警告有效至上午8時30分；教育局宣布所有上午校及全日制學校今日停課。

en.headline: Japanese indie-pop trio Chilli Beans. returns for solo Hong Kong show on 30 August
en.dek: The group, known for the One Piece ending theme Raise and recent Netflix work, performs at Tides after their Clockenflap appearance late last year.

zh.headline: 日本獨立流行組合Chilli Beans. 8月30日再臨香港專場
zh.dek: 憑《海賊王》片尾曲Raise及Netflix動畫主題曲成名的三人組合，繼去年Clockenflap後於Tides舉行演唱會。

en.headline: Police smash multiple illegal fishing-machine dens in Sham Shui Po, arrest 25
en.dek: Officers from Sham Shui Po District raided units on several streets under Operation Rising Sun, seizing dozens of machines, gambling equipment and cash.

zh.headline: 警深水埗搗破多個非法釣魚機賭場 拘25人
zh.dek: 深水埗警區人員展開代號「旭日」行動，搜查南昌街、鴨寮街、長沙灣道及基隆街多個單位，檢獲數十部釣魚機機件、賭具及賭款。

en.headline: Chan Wai-lap’s ceramic bathhouse installation continues at Oi! until 30 August
en.dek: The free exhibition Jeremy’s Bathhouse at Oil Street Art Space features a heart-shaped pool of more than 1,200 handmade tiles and mist effects exploring bathing cultures and connection.

zh.headline: 陳惠立「左旋們浴場」陶瓷裝置展油街實現至8月30日
zh.dek: 免費展覽以逾1,200塊手工陶瓷磚組成心形浴池，結合霧氣效果，探討浴場文化與人際連結，北角油街實現舉行。

en.headline: Mainland monk remanded over alleged theft of Monkey King statue from Tsuen Wan temple
en.dek: Zha Jianxin, 57, a two-way permit holder from Shenzhen, appeared in West Kowloon Court charged with stealing a HK$2,000 copper statue of Sun Wukong from Lung Mo Temple.

zh.headline: 內地和尚涉偷荃灣龍母佛堂孫悟空神像還押
zh.dek: 57歲雙程證持有人查建新被控於8月24日在荃灣龍母佛堂附近偷取價值2,000元銅製孫悟空神像，西九龍裁判法院還押至9月23日再訊。

en.headline: Customs seize HK$11 million of suspected controlled pharmaceuticals in Sheung Shui
en.dek: Officers raided a warehouse used for storage and repackaging, arresting two mainland two-way permit holders and seizing more than 400,000 items mostly for sexual health and cancer treatment.

zh.headline: 海關上水搗破倉庫檢逾1100萬元受管制藥品拘兩人
zh.dek: 關員於上水工廈單位檢獲逾40萬件懷疑受管制藥劑製品，大部分為壯陽藥及抗癌藥，兩名雙程證持有人被捕。

en.headline: Two women arrested after fight at Kwun Tong mall over girl being slapped
en.dek: Police detained a 68-year-old woman and a 34-year-old woman following a viral video of an altercation at the APM shopping centre play area on Wednesday afternoon.

zh.headline: 觀塘apm女童被掌摑混戰 警拘兩女
zh.dek: 周三下午觀塘apm商場遊戲區發生爭執，影片顯示阿婆推撞及掌摑女童後引發混戰，警方拘捕68歲及34歲女子。

en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning reissued after midnight with Thunderstorm Warning still in force
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reissued the Amber Rainstorm Warning shortly after midnight and has the Thunderstorm Warning extended until 3 a.m., expecting heavy rain and squally thunderstorms under an active southerly…

zh.headline: 午夜後再發黃色暴雨警告 雷暴警告延長至凌晨3時
zh.dek: 天文台午夜過後再發出黃色暴雨警告，雷暴警告延長至今日凌晨3時，預料受活躍偏南氣流影響，本港有大雨及狂風雷暴。

en.headline: 20,000 civil servants to join Huanggang Port peak-capacity drill on Saturday
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the second large-scale cross-boundary exercise with Shenzhen will test the new control point under maximum pressure before opening.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸周六兩萬公務員演練測試頂峰承受力
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超表示，港深第二次大型跨境演練將測試口岸高峰承載能力，條件充分時會盡快開通。

en.headline: No lead poisoning cases found after infant formula scare
en.dek: The Department of Health said 237 children who drank a flagged Friso batch have undergone clinical assessment and none showed signs of lead poisoning; a special hotline will close on Friday.

zh.headline: 美素力奶粉事件未發現鉛中毒個案 熱線周五停止
zh.dek: 衞生署表示237名嬰幼兒完成臨床評估，整體健康良好，未有鉛中毒；特別熱線將於周五下午6時起停止運作。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning remains in force until 11:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a few squally thunderstorms are still expected over the territory this evening after the Amber Rainstorm Warning was cancelled earlier.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至晚上11時30分
zh.dek: 天文台表示今晚仍有幾陣狂風雷暴，黃色暴雨警告早前已取消，惟珠江口一帶仍有雷雨區發展。

en.headline: Tai Po water main burst leaves thousands without supply overnight
en.dek: A 200-millimetre fresh-water pipe burst on On Po Road near Tai Yuen Estate; the Water Supplies Department will shut off supply after 11 p.m. for repairs and aims to restore service by noon on Thursday.

zh.headline: 大埔安埔路食水管爆裂 大元邨汀雅苑等近五千戶受影響
zh.dek: 水務署安排今晚11時後停水維修，爭取明日中午12時前恢復供水，並已派出水車及水箱提供臨時食水。

en.headline: John Lee to unveil Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and Policy Address on 16 September
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the two documents would be released together so the public can see how the annual Policy Address implements the longer-term blueprint.

zh.headline: 李家超：9月16日公布首份五年規劃及施政報告
zh.dek: 行政長官表示兩份文件同日發表，方便市民理解五年規劃與年度施政的一脈相承關係。

en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning and Thunderstorm Warning in force this evening
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 6:45 p.m. and extended the Thunderstorm Warning, with violent gusts recorded and further heavy rain expected overnight and tomorrow morning.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨及雷暴警告生效 大澳錄得時速80公里陣風
zh.dek: 天文台下午6時45分發出黃色暴雨警告，雷暴警告延長，預料今晚及明早雨勢有時頗大，並可能有猛烈陣風。

en.headline: John Lee meets Peking University party secretary on higher-education cooperation
en.dek: The Chief Executive discussed Northern Metropolis university-town plans and deeper collaboration through the Beijing-Hong Kong Universities Alliance.

zh.headline: 李家超晤北大黨委書記 談高等教育合作及北都大學城
zh.dek: 雙方就推動港與內地高等教育合作、培育人才及科研協作交流，李家超歡迎北大與本地大學協同發展。

en.headline: Man loses over HK$2.8 million in recyclable-waste investment scam
en.dek: Police recorded more than 50 investment fraud cases in the past week with total losses exceeding HK$30 million; fraudsters posed as electricity company staff.

zh.headline: 男子誤信「環保廢料計劃」失逾280萬 一周逾50宗投資騙案
zh.dek: 騙徒冒充中電及國家電網職員，過去一周投資騙案總損失逾3000萬元。

en.headline: RTHK senior editor given 160 hours community service for upskirt filming
en.dek: Chong Tak-yin, 57, pleaded guilty to unlawful recording of intimate parts after police found a video of a woman in Mong Kok last November.

zh.headline: 港台助理總採訪主任偷拍裙底 判160小時社服令
zh.dek: 57歲莊德賢承認非法拍攝私密部位罪，去年11月在旺角被巡邏警員揭發。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 3:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a few squally thunderstorms are expected over the territory this afternoon under an active southerly airstream.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午3時30分
zh.dek: 天文台表示受活躍偏南氣流影響，預料本港今午有幾陣狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Six men arrested after police dismantle social-media cannabis trafficking group
en.dek: About 7.7 kg of suspected cannabis buds and related products valued at more than HK$1.9 million were seized in raids on bases and stores in Tsuen Wan and Yuen Long.

zh.headline: 警拘6男瓦解社交平台販毒集團 檢值190萬元大麻花
zh.dek: 行動中於荃灣及元朗搗破行動基地及儲存倉，檢獲約7.7公斤懷疑大麻花及相關產品，市值超過190萬元。

en.headline: CFS finds bacterial counts exceeded in Junlebao pure milk samples
en.dek: Four samples of the one-litre product exceeded legal limits; the affected batch remains at the importer’s warehouse and has not entered the market.

zh.headline: 君樂寶純牛奶菌落計數超標 食安中心封存產品暫撤進口准許
zh.dek: 四個樣本菌落計數超出法例標準，受影響批次仍存於進口商貨倉，並無流出市面。

en.headline: Police and Hospital Authority sign MoU on counter-terrorism medical collaboration
en.dek: Commissioner Raymond Siu and HA chief executive Libby Lee signed the agreement covering tactical medical training, on-scene procedures and professional accreditation.

zh.headline: 警方與醫管局簽署諒解備忘錄 深化反恐應變及醫療協作
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴與醫管局行政總裁李夏茵簽署文件，涵蓋戰術醫療訓練、現場處置程序及專業認證等範疇。

en.headline: West Kowloon Emergency Unit officer’s service weapon discharges accidentally while loading
en.dek: One round was fired at about 11:01 p.m. on Tuesday inside the unit’s operations base; no one was injured and the force said the matter is under investigation.

zh.headline: 西九龍衝鋒隊男警配槍上彈走火 射出一子彈無人傷
zh.dek: 一名男警昨晚約11時01分在西九龍總區衝鋒隊行動基地上彈區為配槍入彈時意外走火，發射一發子彈，無人受傷。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 1:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a few squally thunderstorms are expected over the territory this afternoon under an active southerly airstream.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午1時30分
zh.dek: 天文台表示受活躍偏南氣流影響，預料本港今午有幾陣狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Heung Yuen Wai permit holders can use Lok Ma Chau overnight from today
en.dek: Cross-boundary private cars with valid Heung Yuen Wai closed-road permits may cross via Lok Ma Chau between midnight and 6:30 a.m. daily under a new Guangdong-Hong Kong arrangement.

zh.headline: 香園圍許可證跨境私家車今起可通宵經落馬洲過境
zh.dek: 持有香園圍管制站封閉道路通行許可證的跨境私家車，由今日起每日午夜12時至上午6時30分可經落馬洲管制站過境。

en.headline: Two men arrested after drugs found in Tsing Yi light goods vehicle
en.dek: Police seized about 44.5 grams of suspected crack cocaine, e-cigarette cartridges and drug paraphernalia valued at roughly HK$45,000 after a report of suspected drug use late on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 青衣輕型貨車檢懷疑毒品 兩男涉販毒等被捕
zh.dek: 警方接報在青衣楓樹窩路一輛輕型貨車內檢獲約44.5克懷疑霹靂可卡因、電子煙彈及吸食工具，市值約4.5萬元，拘捕兩名男子。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 11:30 a.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the warning issued at 5:20 a.m., expecting a few squally thunderstorms over the territory this morning under an active southerly airstream.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至上午11時30分
zh.dek: 天文台將清晨5時20分發出的雷暴警告延長至上午11時30分，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴，受活躍偏南氣流影響。

en.headline: PLA Hong Kong Garrison completes 29th unit rotation
en.dek: The garrison carried out a scheduled rotation of army, navy and air force units between 24 and 25 August under the Garrison Law and a Central Military Commission order.

zh.headline: 解放軍駐港部隊完成第29次建制單位輪換
zh.dek: 駐港部隊於8月24至25日組織陸軍、海軍、空軍部分兵力進行第29次建制單位輪換，行動全程安全順利。

en.headline: Man arrested in Tsuen Wan car park drug seizure
en.dek: Police detained a 34-year-old local man after finding about 27 grams of suspected ketamine and 23 grams of suspected cocaine valued at roughly HK$26,000 in two private cars.

zh.headline: 荃灣停車場檢獲毒品 34歲男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方在荃灣住宅停車場截查兩輛私家車，檢獲約27克懷疑氯胺酮及23克懷疑可卡因，市值約2.6萬元，拘捕一名34歲本地男子。

en.headline: Man dies after falling from building in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A 55-year-old man was found dead on Tuesday evening after falling from a tenement building near the junction of Nam Cheong Street and Lai Chi Kok Road, striking a parked works vehicle.

zh.headline: 深水埗男子墮樓壓中工程車後死亡
zh.dek: 一名55歲男子周二晚在南昌街近荔枝角道交界大廈墮下，先壓中停泊路邊的渠務工程車再反彈落地，當場不治。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 9:30 a.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the warning issued at 5:20 a.m., expecting a few squally thunderstorms over the territory this morning.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分
zh.dek: 天文台將清晨5時20分發出的雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Trial booking system opens for High Island Reservoir’s Po Toi Chau section
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department has set a daily quota of 2,000 visitors for selected weekends and holidays from 5 September, with online real-name registration via Klook.

zh.headline: 萬宜水庫破邊洲段試行預約制 每日限額二千
zh.dek: 漁護署已開放9月5日起指定周末及假期名額，須經指定平台實名登記，每日合共二千個名額分四個時段。

en.headline: Multi-agency drill tests cross-border ambulance handover at new Huanggang Port
en.dek: Fire Services, Customs, Immigration, the Department of Health and the Government Property Agency simulated a patient transfer from the mainland via the joint one-stop lane on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸多部門演練深港救護車跨境病人交接
zh.dek: 消防、海關、入境處、衞生署及政府產業署周二模擬病人經聯合一站式車道由內地轉交港方救護人員。

en.headline: Customs and Fire Services seize 770 litres of untaxed petrol in Kwai Chung
en.dek: Two mobile illegal petrol stations were uncovered in a public open car park on Stonecutters Island on Monday afternoon; a 26-year-old operator and a 55-year-old driver were arrested.

zh.headline: 海關聯同消防葵涌破兩流動非法加油站 檢770公升未完稅汽油
zh.dek: 周一午在昂船洲公眾露天停車場搗破兩個流動非法電油加油站，拘捕26歲操作員及55歲司機，檢獲約770公升未完稅汽油。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until 7:30 a.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 5:20 a.m., expecting a few squally thunderstorms and intense gusts reaching 70 km/h or above over the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至上午7時30分
zh.dek: 天文台於清晨5時20分發出雷暴警告，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴，並可能出現時速70公里或以上強陣風。

en.headline: Ancient Egypt Unveiled exhibition enters final days at Hong Kong Palace Museum
en.dek: The largest display of ancient Egyptian treasures ever staged in Hong Kong closes on 31 August after nine and a half months, featuring 250 objects from seven Egyptian museums and Saqqara.

zh.headline: 香港故宮「古埃及文明大展」進入最後數天
zh.dek: 本港歷來最大型古埃及文物展將於8月31日閉幕，展出七間埃及博物館及薩卡拉遺址共250件珍藏，為期九個半月。

en.headline: Japanese rock band Novelbright closes two-night Hong Kong stand at MacPherson Stadium…
en.dek: The Osaka group’s Asia Tour PYRAMID final show starts at 7 p.m.; tickets remain available from HK$699 with a VIP option that includes early entry and a photo opportunity.

zh.headline: 日本搖滾樂隊Novelbright今晚麥花臣場館演最終場
zh.dek: 亞洲巡演「PYRAMID」香港站第二晚於晚上7時開始，門票由699港元起，另設含優先入場及合照的VIP套票。

en.headline: British transit passenger arrested with 35 kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport
en.dek: A 19-year-old man arriving from Bangkok and bound for London was stopped on Monday; the drugs in two suitcases are valued at about HK$8.2 million and he appears in court today.

zh.headline: 英籍過境男旅客行李藏35公斤懷疑大麻花被捕
zh.dek: 19歲男子由曼谷抵港擬轉飛倫敦，兩個行李箱檢獲64包懷疑大麻花，市值約820萬元，今日西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Customs seize 12.4 kg of suspected ketamine in air parcel, arrest woman in Kwun Tong
en.dek: Officers found the drugs hidden in plastic buckets declared as swimming-pool sanitisers arriving from Spain via France; a 23-year-old local woman was detained after a controlled delivery.

zh.headline: 海關檢獲12.4公斤懷疑氯胺酮 觀塘拘23歲女子
zh.dek: 空運包裹報稱為泳池消毒劑，內藏膠桶裝懷疑K仔，市值逾500萬元；關員監控遞送後於觀塘拘捕本地女子。

en.headline: Asia’s biggest professional pickleball event set for Kai Tak in October
en.dek: The PPA Asia 1500 Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam will run from 19 to 25 October at Kai Tak Arena with a record US$1.1 million purse and more than 860 players.

zh.headline: 亞洲最大職業匹克球賽10月啟德舉行 獎金110萬美元
zh.dek: PPA亞洲職業匹克球巡迴賽1500級別香港大滿貫將於10月19至25日在啟德體藝館上演，總獎金高達110萬美元，逾860人參賽。

en.headline: Three domestic helpers warned for using employers’ data to obtain loans
en.dek: The Privacy Commissioner found the helpers breached the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance by supplying names, addresses and phone numbers without consent, leading to debt-collector harassment.

zh.headline: 三外傭擅用僱主資料借貸 私隱公署發警告信
zh.dek: 私隱專員裁定三名外籍家庭傭工未經同意向財務機構提供僱主姓名、地址及電話，違反私隱條例，僱主其後遭追債滋擾。

en.headline: Suspect in HK$7 million airport gold robbery arrested after Tate’s Cairn Tunnel crash
en.dek: A 21-year-old man linked to the June gold-bar heist was detained after crashing inside the tunnel early Tuesday; police also seized suspected drugs worth about HK$70,000.

zh.headline: 機場劫金條案再拘一人 大老山隧道撞車後落網
zh.dek: 一名21歲男子被指與6月機場停車場劫去約700萬元金條案有關，周二凌晨在大老山隧道撞車後被捕，並檢獲約7萬元懷疑毒品。

en.headline: Taxi driver dies after three-vehicle crash on Lantau’s Cheung Tung Road
en.dek: A taxi, a Discovery Bay bus and a goods vehicle collided near Sunny Bay around 8 p.m.; the taxi driver later died of his injuries and more than ten people were hurt.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山翔東路三車相撞 的士司機傷重不治
zh.dek: 晚上約八時翔東路近欣澳發生涉及的士、愉景灣巴士及貨車的車禍，的士司機其後傷重不治，逾十人受傷。

en.headline: Chinese Medicine Hospital to launch 24-hour inpatient services on 11 December
en.dek: The Tseung Kwan O facility will open 93 inpatient beds in the first phase, with government-subsidised care priced at a package rate of HK$980 per day.

zh.headline: 香港中醫醫院12月11日起開展24小時住院服務
zh.dek: 將軍澳醫院首階段提供93張住院病床，政府資助服務以每日980元套餐收費，預計2030年底達400張病床。

en.headline: Jewellery shop barred from tour groups for 30 days over coerced shopping
en.dek: The Travel Industry Authority suspended Kaiser Jewellery International from receiving inbound tour groups after finding it failed to stop a guide coercing mainland visitors into purchases.

zh.headline: 凱旋珠寶未制止導遊威迫購物 被旅監局停接待旅行團30日
zh.dek: 旅遊業監管局因2月一宗內地旅行團個案，暫停Kaiser Jewellery International註冊商店資格，由8月26日至9月24日不得接待訪港旅行團。

en.headline: CLP and HK Electric raise September fuel charges amid energy volatility
en.dek: CLP’s fuel adjustment rises marginally to 45.1 cents per unit while HK Electric’s climbs 3.4 cents to 60.7 cents; both offer temporary rebates for lower-usage households.

zh.headline: 中電港燈9月燃料調整費上調 兩電推特別回扣紓緩
zh.dek: 中電燃料調整費微升至每度45.1仙，港燈升3.4仙至60.7仙；兩電均為低用量住宅客戶提供為期三個月的特別回扣或補助。

en.headline: Hong Kong exports surge 50.7 per cent in July on AI electronics demand
en.dek: The value of merchandise exports rose to a record HK$672.5 billion, while imports grew 41 per cent, according to provisional figures from the Census and Statistics Department.

zh.headline: 7月出口按年升50.7% AI相關電子產品需求強勁
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布，7月商品整體出口貨值達6725億元創新高，進口升41%，有形貿易逆差49億元。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 8:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reissued and later extended the warning, expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over the territory this evening.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至晚上8時30分
zh.dek: 天文台下午3時35分發出雷暴警告，其後延長有效時間，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Experts call for safety-by-design to cut construction fatalities
en.dek: Industry leaders urge embedding safety into building plans after 15 fatal industrial accidents were recorded so far this year.

zh.headline: 業界促將安全設計納入建築規劃減致命意外
zh.dek: 建造業今年已錄得15宗致命工業意外，業界領袖呼籲從設計階段納入安全考慮。

en.headline: Senior secondary science and maths curriculum to be revamped from 2029-30
en.dek: The Education Bureau will update physics, chemistry, biology and extended mathematics syllabuses to encourage more students to take multiple science subjects.

zh.headline: 高中數理課程2029/30學年起優化
zh.dek: 教育局將更新物理、化學、生物及數學延伸部分課程，鼓勵更多學生修讀多個理科科目。

en.headline: Green Form home buyers queue for discounted Kowloon Bay flats
en.dek: Flat selection under the Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme 2025 begins, with more than 800 units at Shing Chi Court offered at 60 per cent of market value.

zh.headline: 綠置居九龍灣盛緻苑今日起揀樓
zh.dek: 「綠表置居計劃」2025的揀樓今日展開，九龍灣盛緻苑提供逾800個單位，以市值六折發售。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning remains in force until 1 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reissued the warning at 10.20 a.m., expecting isolated squally thunderstorms and intense gusts over the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至下午1時 局部有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時20分發出雷暴警告，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴，並可能有時速80公里或以上強陣風。

en.headline: Fire at Causeway Bay subdivided flat leaves one woman hospitalised
en.dek: Flames broke out on the ninth floor of Hennessy Apartments on Tuesday morning; 73 people were evacuated and tram services were temporarily suspended.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣軒尼詩大廈劏房起火 73人疏散一名老婦送院
zh.dek: 軒尼詩道488至490號單位今早起火，消防出動撲救，火警約中午12時半救熄，波斯富街一度全線封閉。

en.headline: Tuen Mun water main leaks again near Tun Lai Street
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is investigating a fresh leak on Castle Peak Road after yellow muddy water was seen gushing from the ground on Tuesday morning.

zh.headline: 屯門青山公路近屯利街再爆水管 水務署派人跟進
zh.dek: 水務署接獲報告指青山公路近屯利街有食水供水管滲漏，已派員到場處理，網上片段顯示黃泥水湧出路面。

en.headline: Harry Potter Mahou Dokoro pop-up ends today at Hysan Place
en.dek: The official merchandise store offering apparel, accessories and collectables from the films closes on Tuesday after a month-long run in Causeway Bay.

zh.headline: 哈利波特Mahou Dokoro期間限定店今日結束
zh.dek: 希慎廣場官方周邊店營業至今日，提供電影系列服裝、配件及收藏品。

en.headline: Hong Kong sends record 41 competitors to WorldSkills Shanghai
en.dek: The largest-ever local contingent will take part in 37 skill categories next month, including two events Hong Kong is entering for the first time.

zh.headline: 港隊派歷來最多41人出戰上海世界技能大賽
zh.dek: 第48屆世界技能大賽下月在上海舉行，香港派出41名選手參加37個項目，包括首次出戰的軟件測試及家具製作。

en.headline: Firefighters dismantle precarious scaffolding outside Jordan building
en.dek: A 1.5-metre scaffold erected for air-conditioner works shifted and hung dangerously overnight; one traffic lane was closed during the removal.

zh.headline: 佐敦大廈棚架搖搖欲墜 消防升雲梯拆除
zh.dek: 柯士甸道百安大廈一樓冷氣工程棚架移位懸空，消防凌晨出動雲梯移除，往紅磡方向一度封閉一條行車線。

en.headline: Suspended police officer appears in court over alleged HK$4.2 million mortgage fraud
en.dek: A 32-year-old officer attached to Kwai Tsing district faces two counts of fraud after allegedly submitting false documents to a bank in 2021.

zh.headline: 男警涉虛假文件申420萬按揭貸款 今沙田提堂
zh.dek: 32歲葵青警區男警被控兩項欺詐罪，指他於2021年向銀行提供虛假文件及資料騙取約420萬元按揭貸款。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning reissued until 11:30 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a fresh Thunderstorm Warning at 10:20 a.m., expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告再發至上午11時30分
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時20分再發雷暴警告，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Japanese rock band Novelbright opens two-night Hong Kong stand at MacPherson Stadium…
en.dek: The Osaka group’s Asia Tour PYRAMID shows run on 25 and 26 August, with tickets from HK$699 and a VIP package including early entry and a photo opportunity.

zh.headline: 日本搖滾樂隊Novelbright今晚起麥花臣場館兩晚演出
zh.dek: 亞洲巡演「PYRAMID」於8月25及26日晚上7時舉行，門票由699港元起，另設VIP套票包括優先入場及合照機會。

en.headline: Two private cars collide inside Tate's Cairn Tunnel, one driver injured
en.dek: The early-morning crash on the northbound carriageway caused temporary congestion; one driver sustained minor injuries.

zh.headline: 大老山隧道兩私家車相撞 一司機輕傷
zh.dek: 今晨約3時北行線發生車禍，其中一輛車車頭嚴重損毀，隧道一度擠塞。

en.headline: Alisan Fine Arts opens Tradition Renewed ink exhibition in Central today
en.dek: The show marking the gallery’s 45th anniversary features four contemporary literati masters and runs until mid-November, with an opening reception this evening.

zh.headline: 藝倡畫廊今日開幕《傳統再造》水墨展
zh.dek: 畫廊45周年項目展出四位當代文人畫家作品，展期至11月中，今晚5時半至7時半舉行開幕酒會。

en.headline: Man arrested after parrot found with clipped wings and bloodstains in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 39-year-old owner was detained on suspicion of cruelty to animals after a resident reported an injured bird near Po Lam Road North on Monday evening.

zh.headline: 將軍澳鸚鵡疑遭剪翼流血 39歲男主人涉虐畜被捕
zh.dek: 市民周一晚在寶琳北路發現受傷成鳥，翅膀羽毛被剪並帶血漬，警方拘捕姓張男主人，案件交將軍澳警區跟進。

en.headline: Parents arrested after 2-year-old left alone in Yuen Long village house
en.dek: A neighbour reported the toddler alone at a Kung Um Road address late on Monday; the child was found conscious with a swollen foot and taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 元朗2歲男童疑被獨留家中 父母涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 鄰居昨晚約10時報警指公庵路村屋有幼童獨留，警方到場發現男童清醒腳部紅腫，父母涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until 8:30 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 2:33 a.m. and later extended it, expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至上午8時30分
zh.dek: 天文台於凌晨2時33分發出雷暴警告，其後延長至今早8時30分，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。

en.headline: Free dental check-ups for kindergarten children start on 1 September
en.dek: The Department of Health’s new Outreach Oral Health Programme will send professional teams to schools for annual screenings and fluoride treatment; more than 70 per cent of kindergartens have already joined.

zh.headline: 學前兒童口腔健康外展計劃9月1日推出 七成幼稚園已參與
zh.dek: 衞生署新計劃將派出牙科團隊到校為幼稚園學童提供免費口腔檢查及預防服務，目前已有逾七成幼稚園報名。

en.headline: Consortium wins first Northern Metropolis large-scale land tender for HK$1.03 billion
en.dek: A six-company group including China Overseas, China Resources Land, Sino Land and JD.com will develop about 10.5 hectares in Hung Shui Kiu, providing around 3,000 flats and a smart logistics centre.

zh.headline: 北部都會區洪水橋大規模土地批出首標 財團以10.3億元中標
zh.dek: 由中海外、華潤置地、信和及京東等六企組成的財團投得約10.5公頃用地，將提供約3,000個住宅單位及智慧物流中心。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for eastern waters until 9:30 pm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8:15 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over the eastern waters of Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告至晚上9時半 預料東部水域局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台晚上8時15分發出雷暴警告，有效至今晚9時30分，預料香港東部水域有局部地區雷暴。
